description.en: Deterministic claim support checking for DeepSeek Harness: verbatim quote spans, number matching, labelled-value contradiction, negation and hedging polarity against the cited sentence, REP v1 evidence/claim/verdict records and SARIF output.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的确定性论断支持检查：逐字引文跨度、数字匹配、标值矛盾、否定与模糊语极性对照被引句，生成 REP v1 证据/论断/裁决记录与 SARIF 输出。
